mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns remain positive in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off flows that produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in less than 40% of cases when UNRATE > 4.0% over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output below 100 (INDPRO) signals supply chain disruption, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth fails to correlate with positive 20d SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.05) over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 260 signals accelerating inflation, prompting anticipated monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in less than 40% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 260 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market collapse, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1600 thousand units signal weakening residential demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1600 over any 1-year window.
